checks.rule: RXD_3V3 at VCC max must not exceed ESP32 VDD+0.3 V
RXD_3V3 HIGH at VCC min must exceed ESP32 VIH (0.75 VDD)
S held >= 0.7 VCC (Silent) by R1 to +5V_CAN
No MCU GPIO is connected to S in the receive-only revision
GPIO21 does not drive TXD (3.3 V is below TXD VIH = 3.5 V)
Pin 5 left open: fail-safe for n.c., VIO and EN variants (AH1014 Table 21)
Termination is a bus-topology decision and is not fitted by default
